external trunk advancement rejected before new semantic review

limitations: Offline Supervisor tests use real local Git and immutable control stores with simulated GitHub and management responses; no live model worker is launched.
The dependent join and full installed Objective have not completed.
A validator interrupted before its completion checkpoint still requires independent resource reconciliation; it is not automatically relaunched.
GitHub REST squash merge does not provide base-SHA compare-and-swap; a competing external base write is detected by post-merge parent/tree verification, not atomically prevented.
Registry installation, published provenance, the complete Linux matrix, live native stacks, managed providers, Daytona burst, and successor execution retain their separate release gates.
